title: Low Roasted Dutch Chicken Tagine
description: A roasted Dutch dish featuring chicken cooked in a tagine pot with mirin and honey, served as a solo dinner, this recipe is low glycemic friendly and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a tagine pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mirin and honey.
Pour the mirin and honey mixture over the chicken and onion.
Add the dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the tagine pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the chicken for 30 minutes or until it is cooked through.
